about_the_game:
Welcome to the OverField demo! This brief demo will show you the missions of being an explorer in unknown dimensional spaces! Spatial distortions are intensifying, and you must begin your investigation immediately!

A new dimension is unfolding. Now you need to complete initial tasks, including assisting Rota Technology in preparing for the first spatial traversal.

OverField is Rota Technology's latest spatial exploration adventure game. Through this free demo, we hope to let you preview the unique charm of the full version! This demo includes the first three chapters.

Features:
• First Steps into OverField - Get an early look at our upcoming high-quality new title. OverField is a classic Rota Technology solo exploration adventure set in distortion-filled modern times where you play as a rookie explorer.
• Solve Spatial Puzzles - Start your first mission as a spatial explorer from Rota Garden. Explore specific areas in alternate dimensions, meet your guide and companions, and complete all investigations!
• Immersive Environmental Soundtrack - Surrounding background music created by renowned composers will create the perfect atmosphere during your exploration missions.

Demo includes:
• 4 carefully designed spatial domains
• Practical experience with 4 basic spatial crafting skills
• Complete character progression system preview
• Captivating prologue storyline

  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1060

short_description: Play the "Over Field" Demo! Become an explorer in solo otherworldly adventures and compete with players worldwide! Build your home at Rota Plaza, gather spatial resources, use devices, find relics, challenge Anomalies with skills, and teleport to uncharted realms!

English, Japanese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
